# traceability-audit

> Multilingual theory text for SynomosAI's AI Governance Four Pillars (Identity · Traceability · Governance · Symbiosis): Chinese main THEORY + 8 translations (ar/de/en/es/fr/ja/pt/ru), bilingual zh-en alignment, nine-language pointer index, attribution spec.

A content-only repo hosting the theory package. It states the four-pillar worldview; it runs no checks.

## Core

- [theory/THEORY.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/traceability-audit/blob/main/theory/THEORY.md): four-pillar theory text (Chinese main)
- [theory/THEORY.en.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/traceability-audit/blob/main/theory/THEORY.en.md): English translation
- [gov_theory-pointer-index_multi_v0.1-theory-stance.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/traceability-audit/blob/main/gov_theory-pointer-index_multi_v0.1-theory-stance.md): nine-language pointer index
- [gov_attribution-spec_v0.1-theory-stance.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/traceability-audit/blob/main/gov_attribution-spec_v0.1-theory-stance.md): attribution spec
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/SynomosAI/traceability-audit/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
